summary.text: Michelle Hinchey is a Democratic state senator who represents New York State Senate District 41 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hinchey, who chairs the Senate Agriculture Committee, has served in the Senate since 2021 and is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Michelle Hinchey was born in Saugerties, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from Cornell University in 2009.

Her career experience includes working as executive director of corporate communications for the EPIX TV network and as a grassroots organizer with Environment NY, and she has served on the board of directors of the Catskill Center for Conservation and Development.

Hinchey won the 2020 general election for New York State Senate District 46 over Richard Amedure, Robert Alft Jr. and Gary Greenberg, and she won District 41 in 2022 by defeating incumbent Susan Serino.
She defeated Patrick Sheehan in the 2024 general election.

In the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Senate Agriculture Committee and also sits on the Cultural Affairs, Tourism, Parks and Recreation; Energy and Telecommunications; Internet and Technology; Transportation; Environmental Conservation; and Finance committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Hinchey faces Patrick Sheehan (R / Conservative Party).
